name: agent-skills-manager
description: Install, discover, list, update and remove Agent Skills from user-selected GitHub repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Install and manage Agent Skills from GitHub
interface.longDescription: Install all or selected Agent Skills from GitHub repositories you choose, inspect existing skills, preserve local changes, and manage updates or removal after reviewing any actual write. Repository browsing and comparisons are read-only. Native installation depends on available permissions; Plugin Creator is an optional verified fallback. No preset repositories or shared user data.
capabilities: Discover and install all or selected skills from a user-provided GitHub repository
Reconcile existing local skills without overwriting user modifications
List managed skills, check source updates and plan approved changes
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Skills Manager to install all Agent Skills from a GitHub repository I provide. Preserve existing local changes and ask once before any actual write.
Show my installed Agent Skills and verified update status.
Find Agent Skills in a GitHub repository I provide, without installing them.
Check my installed Agent Skills for updates without modifying anything.
